# TETO FULL-EXPANSION 177 — plan table generator (docs-only, stdlib only).
# Input : the #781 rows JSON (read-only re-use; regenerated byte-identical on main e6b205c by #781's own script).
# Output: docs/reports/data/TETO_FULL-EXPANSION-177_plan.json  +  markdown tables on stdout.
# Run   : python3 -I docs/reports/data/TETO_FULL-EXPANSION-177_plan.py.txt <rows_781.json> <out.json> > tables.md
# `.txt` so CI's extension classifier treats it as docs (same convention as #781).
import json, sys, collections

rows_path, out_path = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
src = json.load(open(rows_path, encoding="utf-8"))
rows = src["rows"]

# ---- mechanic key -> workstream-M track + existing issue/PR (fresh GitHub state 2026-11-07) ----
MECH = {
  "DOUGH_VARIANT":          ("M1", "#577 (PR #775 PD-1a open) -> PD-1b/c -> PD-2 chip UI -> PD-3 data"),
  "PAN_BAKE:other":         ("M2", "#532/#538 square-pan line + #773 (deep/shallow/steel profile: design only)"),
  "DOUGH_SHAPE_TARGET":     ("M2", "#532/#536 (square fill exists for tray) + #773 (oval/boat/rect target: design only)"),
  "ENCLOSE":                ("M3", "#773 FOLD+SEAL (PR #785 F1 HOLD, F2 lab claim)"),
  "LATE_ADDITION:mid_bake": ("M4", "#604/#611 (post_bake shipped; mid_bake: NO issue yet -> new)"),
  "PREP_STEP":              ("M5", "#696 / prepExperienceGate (PREP_EXPERIENCE_PRODUCTION=false; Owner ON)"),
  "FRY_COOK":               ("M5", "#749 (FRY_EXPERIENCE_PRODUCTION=false; F1-F3 + Owner ON)"),
  "STEP_ORDER":             ("M6", "NO issue yet (cheese-under-sauce order) -> new; PR #620 audit adjacent"),
  "ZONED_PLACEMENT":        ("M6", "#773 / PR #620 ZONED audit (design only)"),
  "LAMINATE":               ("M6", "NO issue yet -> new (feteer only; candidate to defer)"),
  "MULTI_SPREAD_LAYER":     ("M6", "#521 (2 layers shipped); 3rd / non-sauce layer: design only"),
}
IN_FLIGHT = {  # rows another live claim/PR already owns -> excluded from this plan's implementation lanes
  "pesto-burrata-pizzadb-p12":       "Batch 19 PR #783 (#774) — Final Gate kept separately",
  "pizza-alla-crudaiola-pizzadb-p8": "Batch 19 PR #783 (#774) — Final Gate kept separately",
  "pesto-noci-pizzadb-p12":          "B20-A (#780 T5 decision): HOLD until #783 merges",
}

# ---- 73-ingredient re-audit (manual judgement, labelled 【推論】 in the report) ----
# kind: VEG / FRUIT / CHEESE / MEAT / SEAFOOD / NUT / SPICE / SAUCE / LIQUID(post-bake drizzle) / DESSERT / COMPOSITE
# risk: OK | ALIAS:<existing id> (could reuse a shipped id) | PAIR:<other candidate> (merge/split decision) | COMPOSITE (prepared dish) | SAUCE_LINE (needs sauce profile)
ING = {
 "honey":("LIQUID","OK"), "walnut":("NUT","OK"), "lettuce":("VEG","OK"), "burrata":("CHEESE","OK"),
 "blue-cheese-dressing":("SAUCE","ALIAS:gorgonzola"), "carrot":("VEG","OK"), "cucumber":("VEG","OK"),
 "french-fries":("COMPOSITE","COMPOSITE (=potato+FRY? #749)"), "apple":("FRUIT","OK"), "cheddar":("CHEESE","OK"),
 "ground-beef":("MEAT","ALIAS:beef"), "salsa":("SAUCE","ALIAS:fresh-tomato/tomato-sauce"), "tortilla-chips":("COMPOSITE","COMPOSITE"),
 "buffalo-sauce":("SAUCE","SAUCE_LINE"), "kebab-sauce":("SAUCE","SAUCE_LINE"), "caciocavallo":("CHEESE","OK"),
 "brie":("CHEESE","OK"), "chocolate":("DESSERT","PAIR:nutella-spread"), "graham-cracker":("DESSERT","COMPOSITE"),
 "marshmallow":("DESSERT","OK"), "peanut-sauce":("SAUCE","SAUCE_LINE"), "eel":("SEAFOOD","OK"), "sansho-pepper":("SPICE","OK"),
 "cumin":("SPICE","OK"), "bonito-flakes":("SEAFOOD","OK"), "cabbage":("VEG","PAIR:red-cabbage"),
 "okonomiyaki-sauce":("SAUCE","SAUCE_LINE"), "kimchi":("VEG","OK"), "chicken-tikka":("COMPOSITE","ALIAS:chicken (+PREP/sauce)"),
 "spicy-salami":("MEAT","ALIAS:salami/pepperoni"), "brick-cheese":("CHEESE","ALIAS:mozzarella (Detroit only)"),
 "banana":("FRUIT","OK"), "nutella-spread":("SAUCE","PAIR:chocolate"), "powdered-sugar":("DESSERT","OK"),
 "daikon":("VEG","OK"), "liver-pate":("COMPOSITE","COMPOSITE"), "cauliflower":("VEG","OK"),
 "yogurt-sauce":("SAUCE","SAUCE_LINE"), "asparagus":("VEG","OK"), "celery":("VEG","OK"), "fennel":("VEG","OK"),
 "orange":("FRUIT","OK"), "red-cabbage":("VEG","PAIR:cabbage"), "sunflower-seeds":("NUT","OK"),
 "chicory":("VEG","PAIR:puntarelle/radicchio"), "pecorino":("CHEESE","ALIAS:grana-padano/parmigiano (Hint class)"),
 "puntarelle":("VEG","PAIR:chicory"), "balsamic-vinegar":("LIQUID","OK (#579 DRIZZLE)"), "radicchio":("VEG","PAIR:chicory"),
 "cheese-curd":("CHEESE","OK"), "gravy-sauce":("SAUCE","SAUCE_LINE"), "condensed-milk":("LIQUID","OK"),
 "melted-butter":("LIQUID","OK"), "rock-salt":("SPICE","OK"), "blueberry":("FRUIT","OK"), "kiwi":("FRUIT","OK"),
 "strawberry":("FRUIT","OK"), "squid":("SEAFOOD","OK"), "aji-amarillo":("SAUCE","SAUCE_LINE"), "natto":("COMPOSITE","OK"),
 "okra":("VEG","OK"), "peking-duck":("COMPOSITE","COMPOSITE"), "sweet-bean-sauce":("SAUCE","SAUCE_LINE"),
 "mentaiko":("SEAFOOD","ALIAS:cod-roe"), "mochi":("COMPOSITE","OK"), "halloumi":("CHEESE","OK"), "zaatar":("SPICE","OK"),
 "yakiniku-sauce":("SAUCE","SAUCE_LINE"), "chili-powder":("SPICE","ALIAS:paprika-powder"), "cotija":("CHEESE","ALIAS:feta"),
 "lime":("FRUIT","PAIR:lemon(shipped)"), "truffle":("COMPOSITE","OK (form: shaved/oil undecided)"), "chutney":("SAUCE","SAUCE_LINE"),
}

def mech_missing(r):
    return sorted(set(k["key"] for k in r["mechanicMissingOrGated"]))

def lane(r):
    if r["evidenceId"] in IN_FLIGHT: return "IN_FLIGHT"
    m = mech_missing(r)
    if not m: return "R-A" if not r["newIngredients"] else "R-B"   # R-A: no new ingredient, no new mechanic
    tracks = sorted(set(MECH[k][0] for k in m))
    return "R-C:" + "+".join(tracks)

out = []
for r in rows:
    m = mech_missing(r)
    out.append({
      "evidenceId": r["evidenceId"], "nameJa": r["nameJa"],
      "lane": lane(r),
      "newIngredients": r["newIngredients"],
      "mechanicsMissing": m,
      "mechanicTracks": sorted(set(MECH[k][0] for k in m)),
      "mechanicIssues": [MECH[k][1] for k in m],
      "sauceStatus": r["sauceStatus"], "doughVariant": r["doughVariant"], "pan": r["pan"],
      "ownerDecision": r["class"] == "OWNER_DECISION",
      "ownerReason": r["primaryOwnerReason"] or "",
      "blockerTypes": r["blockerTypes"], "reviewItemTypes": r["reviewItemTypes"],
      "dupGate": r["dupGate"], "maxJaccard": r["jaccardTop3"][0] if r["jaccardTop3"] else None,
      "identitySetComplete": r["identitySetComplete"],
      "inFlight": IN_FLIGHT.get(r["evidenceId"]),
      "source": r["sourceOrigin"],
    })

ing_use = collections.defaultdict(list)
for r in out:
    for i in r["newIngredients"]: ing_use[i].append(r["evidenceId"])
assert set(ing_use) == set(ING), sorted(set(ing_use) ^ set(ING))
ings = []
for i, uses in sorted(ing_use.items(), key=lambda kv: (-len(kv[1]), kv[0])):
    kind, risk = ING[i]
    lanes = sorted(set(next(x["lane"] for x in out if x["evidenceId"] == u) for u in uses))
    ings.append({"id": i, "uses": len(uses), "kind": kind, "risk": risk, "recipes": uses, "lanes": lanes,
                 "inFlightOnly": all(u in IN_FLIGHT for u in uses)})

summary = {
  "baseline": {"mainCommit": "e6b205c", "shippedRecipes": src["summary"]["auditedRecipes"],
               "shippedIngredients": src["summary"]["productionIngredientCount"],
               "unshippedRows": len(out), "target": src["summary"]["auditedRecipes"] + len(out)},
  "laneCounts": dict(collections.Counter(x["lane"] for x in out)),
  "trackCounts": dict(collections.Counter(t for x in out for t in x["mechanicTracks"])),
  "ownerDecisionRows": sum(x["ownerDecision"] for x in out),
  "ownerReasonCounts": dict(collections.Counter(x["ownerReason"] for x in out if x["ownerDecision"])),
  "ingredientCount": len(ings),
  "ingredientKindCounts": dict(collections.Counter(x["kind"] for x in ings)),
  "ingredientRiskCounts": dict(collections.Counter(x["risk"].split(":")[0].split(" ")[0] for x in ings)),
  "singleUseIngredients": sum(1 for x in ings if x["uses"] == 1),
  "identityIncompleteRows": sum(1 for x in out if not x["identitySetComplete"]),
}
json.dump({"summary": summary, "recipes": out, "ingredients": ings}, open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8"),
          ensure_ascii=False, indent=1, sort_keys=True)

# ---- markdown tables ----
P = print
P("### A. レシピ全量依存表（87 行）\n")
P("| # | evidenceId | 名前 | レーン | 新食材 | 不足工程（トラック） | ソース | Owner判断 | 重複ゲート |")
P("|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
order = {"IN_FLIGHT":0, "R-A":1, "R-B":2}
for n, x in enumerate(sorted(out, key=lambda x: (order.get(x["lane"], 3), x["lane"], x["evidenceId"])), 1):
    mt = ",".join(f'{k}({MECH[k][0]})' for k in x["mechanicsMissing"]) or "-"
    od = (x["ownerReason"] or "review") if x["ownerDecision"] else "-"
    P(f'| {n} | `{x["evidenceId"]}` | {x["nameJa"]} | {x["lane"]} | {", ".join(x["newIngredients"]) or "-"} | {mt} | {x["sauceStatus"]} | {od} | {x["dupGate"]} |')
P("\n### B. 食材 73 種の再監査\n")
P("| # | id | 使用数 | 種別 | 重複・別名リスク | 依存レシピのレーン |")
P("|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
for n, x in enumerate(ings, 1):
    P(f'| {n} | `{x["id"]}` | {x["uses"]} | {x["kind"]} | {x["risk"]} | {", ".join(x["lanes"])} |')
P("\n```json\n" + json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1, sort_keys=True) + "\n```")
